issues.problem: ZH adds the consequence of Miao Xian's course of action — 「倒还有活路」, i.e. confessing this way still leaves a way to survive — but EN stops at 'Better to strip and lie on the block ... and ask pardon' and gives no reason or payoff.
issues.suggestion: Change to: Better to "strip and lie on the block", as the phrase went, and ask pardon — there might still be a way to keep his life.

issues.problem: EN adds 'his courage known to every state', which is not in this ZH field (it appears only in sections.hook.0 as 以勇气闻名诸侯); ZH context.0 ends at 拜为上卿.
issues.suggestion: Delete 'his courage known to every state' (or add 以勇气闻名诸侯 to the ZH field).

overall: The two editions match closely in facts, names, dates, quotations and hedges, with only one small omitted clause and one small added clause.
